title: Group Anagrams
statement: Implement `solve(words)`. Group words that are anagrams of each other. The signature is the word's characters sorted. Return a list of groups. Groups follow the order of first appearance of each signature. Words inside a group keep their input order.
constraints: words is a list of lowercase strings in the tests
Do not sort the groups by size
hints: Remember the order in which keys first appear.
Append each word to that key's list.

approaches.name: Signature map
approaches.explanation: An anagram class is the multiset of characters, and the sorted string is a hashable picture of that multiset.

editorial: An anagram class is the multiset of characters, and the sorted string is a hashable picture of that multiset. A dict of lists groups the words. Tracking key order separately, or using a dict which preserves insertion order, returns groups in first-seen order rather than in hash order.
